科创板块，聚焦智慧科创总部（九宫格）、科创未来街区，着力打造千亿级AI产业联盟: The sci-tech innovation section focuses on the smart sci-tech innovation headquarters (nine-grid) and the Sci-Tech Innovation Future Block, striving to build a hundred-billion-yuan-level AI industry alliance.
坝上风光赋能绿色算力 河北张家口探索算电融合新路径: Bashang scenery empowers green computing power: Zhangjiakou, Hebei explores a new path of integrating computing power and electricity.
依托得天独厚的风光资源，河北省张家口市拥有两块分量十足的金字招牌：全国非水可再生: Relying on its exceptional wind and solar resources, Zhangjiakou City, Hebei Province, holds two weighty gold-lettered signboards: China's largest city for non-hydro renewable energy and a national hub node city of the national integrated computing power network.
如今，两大金字招牌发挥的优势深度碰撞：风与光转化的绿色电力源源不断流向数据机房，: Today, the advantages of these two gold-lettered signboards are colliding in depth: green electricity converted from wind and solar flows continuously into data centers, while computing power clusters, as major electricity consumers, help keep the grid controllable and adjustable through stable consumption and energy switching—here, green electricity and computing power achieve a two-way pursuit and symbiotic coexistence.
算力中心用电量达101.73亿千瓦时，同比增长49.77%，多家算力企业绿电使用: Electricity consumption of computing power centers reached 10.173 billion kilowatt-hours, up 49.77% year-on-year, with green electricity usage rates of several computing power enterprises exceeding 90%.
张家口坚持系统思维，统筹新能源开发、电网网架、算力集群一体化谋划，将算力负荷特性: Zhangjiakou adheres to systems thinking, coordinating integrated planning of new energy development, the grid structure, and computing power clusters, and incorporates computing power load characteristics into regional energy development planning and design. The State Grid Zhangjiakou Power Supply Company has specially set up a 'computing power + electricity' coordination task force, continuously tracking the business types, commissioning schedules and construction scales of 25 computing power projects under construction, and scientifically assessing medium- and long-term electricity demand based on variables such as equipment iteration and business development, providing solid data support for grid engineering construction, transmission corridor reservation, and optimized allocation of energy resources.
在张家口市怀来县，秦淮数据怀来桑园云计算产业基地正在推动绿电直连项目建设，风光绿: In Huailai County, Zhangjiakou City, the Sangyuan Cloud Computing Industry Base of Chindata is advancing a direct green electricity connection project, through which wind and solar green electricity will be delivered directly via dedicated lines to the computing power rooms, achieving physical direct supply of green electricity and local consumption.
基地还落地行业首个基于SST（固态变压器）的算力中心智能直流供电商业化方案，这套: The base has also landed the industry's first commercialized smart DC power supply solution for computing power centers based on SST (solid-state transformers). This new power supply architecture achieves a power supply efficiency of 98.5% and occupies less than half the footprint of traditional solutions; with integrated energy storage, it enables seamless switching among multiple power supply modes, balancing peak shaving and valley filling with emergency backup, and drives computing power facilities to shift from 'adapting to the grid' to 'supporting the grid.'
张家口创新算力项目全周期用电服务实行专属对接、一窗受理、全程帮办，保障项目边调试: Zhangjiakou innovates with full-cycle electricity services for computing power projects, implementing dedicated contacts, one-window acceptance, and full-process assisted handling, ensuring projects can debug and commence production simultaneously.
把握住有色金属行业的好行情（有感而发）: Seizing the good market momentum in the nonferrous metals industry (personal reflections)
好行情就是最好的研发激励，当前人工智能、算力基础设施、新能源汽车、新型电力系统等: Good market conditions are the best incentive for R&D. Currently, industries such as artificial intelligence, computing power infrastructure, new energy vehicles, and new-type power systems are developing rapidly, generating new demand for copper, aluminum, lithium, nickel, as well as high-performance alloys and electronic materials.
从Token上电商货架看消费深刻变革（每周经济评论）: Token on the e-commerce shelf: seeing the profound transformation of consumption (Weekly Economic Review)
京东数据显示，11月2日京东3C数码采销直播间2小时直播期间，大模型Token包: JD.com data shows that during a two-hour livestream of JD's 3C digital procurement and sales livestream room on November 2, sales of large model Token packages grew 20-fold month-on-month.
Token摆上货架，既是人工智能加速融入生产生活的生动缩影，也是中国经济向新向优: Tokens on the shelf are both a vivid microcosm of artificial intelligence accelerating its integration into production and life, and a clear footnote to China's economy developing toward the new and the better.
从智能穿戴设备的人机交互，到智能体辅助日常办公，越来越多的消费场景正在与人工智能: From human-machine interaction on smart wearables to AI agents assisting daily office work, more and more consumption scenarios are deeply integrating with artificial intelligence.
为Token付费，本质上是为效率提升、创意赋能和智能服务买单，折射消费需求从传统: Paying for Tokens is essentially paying for improved efficiency, empowered creativity, and intelligent services, reflecting consumer demand extending from traditional physical goods to digital services and intelligent experiences.
人工智能时代，当消费者愿意为智能化的生产生活方式付费，“囤Token”自然就有了: In the age of artificial intelligence, when consumers are willing to pay for intelligent ways of production and living, 'stockpiling Tokens' naturally gains its driving force.
从软件开发到产品设计，再到后期宣发，中小企业的人工智能应用场景不断扩围，这背后是: From software development to product design to post-production promotion, AI application scenarios for small and medium-sized enterprises keep expanding. Behind this is the real economy's urgent desire for intelligent transformation, as well as the intrinsic requirement of promoting the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries and cultivating and strengthening new quality productive forces.
在科技创新和产业创新深度融合的背景下，人工智能正成为重塑未来发展格局的关键力量: Against the backdrop of deep integration of scientific and industrial innovation, artificial intelligence is becoming a key force reshaping the future development landscape.
在生产车间，工业质检、供应链调度因人工智能而更加精准高效: In production workshops, industrial quality inspection and supply chain scheduling are becoming more precise and efficient thanks to artificial intelligence.
中小企业购买Token，说明人工智能正从“可选项”变为“必选项”，千行百业的数字: Small and medium-sized enterprises purchasing Tokens shows that artificial intelligence is shifting from an 'option' to a 'necessity,' and the digital transformation of thousands of industries is accelerating.
当大模型从实验室走向生产一线，算力就如同工业时代的电力，成为不可或缺的新型生产要: As large models move from laboratories to the production frontline, computing power, like electricity in the industrial age, has become an indispensable new production factor, injecting strong momentum into the shift between old and new growth drivers.
”从研发端人工智能大模型更新迭代，到生产端、消费端的普遍应用，中国凭借超大规模市: "From the updating and iteration of AI large models on the R&D end to widespread application on the production and consumption ends, China, with its super-large market, not only provides vast testing grounds for all kinds of new products and new business forms, but also supplies abundant nutrients for the growth of new forms of intelligent economy.
在超大规模市场中，海量应用场景能够支撑大模型以较低成本快速迭代，智能经济的规模效: In the super-large market, massive application scenarios can support large models in iterating rapidly at lower cost, fully releasing the scale effects of the intelligent economy.
市场优势与创新活力相互激荡，不仅让算力服务从企业专属走向大众普及，更构筑起我国在: Market advantages and innovation vitality reinforce each other, not only making computing power services move from enterprise-exclusive to mass adoption, but also building China's new competitive advantages in the era of artificial intelligence.
今年10月，中办国办发布的《关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见》提出，全面: In October this year, the Opinions on Promoting the Deep Integration of Scientific and Technological Innovation and Industrial Innovation issued by the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council proposed fully implementing the 'AI+' initiative to promote all-round AI empowerment of thousands of industries.
随着人工智能技术不断成熟、应用场景持续拓展，涓涓细流汇成江海，为中国经济高质量发: As artificial intelligence technology continues to mature and application scenarios keep expanding, trickling streams converge into rivers and seas, injecting a steady stream of new momentum into China's high-quality economic development.
